description: This file implements the Ocdm class and factory functions related to Open Content Decryption Module (OCDM) support within the Rialto server component. It includes functions for creating and retrieving OCDM instances and checking if a specific key system type is supported.

classes.name: OcdmFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating and managing instances of the OCDM interface.

classes.name: Ocdm
classes.description: Class providing methods to interact with the OCDM, such as checking support for key system types.

methods.name: IOcdmFactory::createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an OCDM factory instance.

methods.name: OcdmFactory::getOcdm
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the current OCDM instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: Ocdm::isTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given key system type is supported by the OCDM.
